mechanism: Use the v20 causal daily profit lock and executable-net exits, requesting a fixed 600 USD core position whose full capacity is verified fail-closed at the later causal entry book rather than capping size from the earlier reference book.
temporal_operator: Process TRAIN signals in observable-time order. Before each signal, sum only same-day PnL already realized. Below 4 USD request a 600 USD core entry after the canonical delay and let the observed entry book accept or reject it all-or-none; above 4 USD request a 75 USD new-vault probe. Close at the first fully liquidatable net -50 or +100 bps crossing, otherwise at one hour.
conditioning: first leader fill at least 100 USD known at signal time
fixed 600 USD core request accepted only when the causal entry book fills it completely
post-lock new-vault probe fixed at 75 USD
maximum one admitted entry per vault and coin per UTC day
executable-net stop loss 50 bps and take profit 100 bps
canonical costs and exact observed five-level VWAP
same identities and sizes for direction-flip placebo
only complete causal actual and placebo episodes aggregated
execution_translation: Paper-only stateful risk controller. The process always scans, while exposure drops after realized daily profit and every position has a causal loss and profit boundary. No order, collector, future PnL, or invented liquidity is used.
prediction_target: At least 4 USD net per TRAIN day with eight trades across three days, profit factor above one, placebo beaten, positive 432-trial-adjusted total lower bound, top positive trade share and largest vault and coin shares at most 60 percent, all episodes complete, and net-risk exits audited.
falsification_test: Reject this single fixed policy if any TRAIN gate fails. Heldout and forward remain unopened before physical freeze.
notes: All predeclared TRAIN gates passed. Parameters, exact TRAIN bounds, input sizes and fingerprints were physically frozen before any validation, OOS, or post-freeze evaluation.
rationale: V20 passed all gates except a slightly negative adjusted lower bound because STBL was capped to 112.22 USD by the earlier reference book despite the actual causal entry book supporting a larger all-or-none fill. Entry-time capacity is the executable fact used by the live order gate; removing the stale pre-entry cap remains fail-closed and targets the sole measured weakness.
